dataSetInformation.common:generalComment: Data about the CRT tube production, taken from a US LCA study of CRT and LCD screens. Data represent the production of an average 17inch CRT computer screen in the late 1990s.; UUID: a16b491e-fea2-3852-ba88-c5d089e279ba

locationOfOperationSupplyOrProduction.descriptionOfRestrictions: Data from a US LCA study used as global average data

technology.technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse:
average CRT production technology in the late 1990s

# Included processes
This module includes the following production steps: production of the shadow mask, frame around the CRT, production of the cathode ray tube (i.e. coating of inner side, installation of electron gun & shadow mask, fixation of funnel and panel parts, evacuation) and paletting until the complete CRT are ready for the next production step.
